proposal.thesis: Baker Hughes printed a record $10.5B in Q2 orders (+49% YoY), including a record $7.1B in Industrial & Energy Technology bookings, and raised both its FY2026 guidance (revenue to $27.35B, adjusted EBITDA to $4.85B) and its 2026-2028 IET orders outlook to over $45B (earnings release, 2026-07-27). The stock confirmed a volume breakout the same day (+5.83%, 1.76x average volume, pocket pivot, gap 99% retained) after basing for two weeks following a -22% decline from May's highs, reclaiming both its 20- and 50-day moving averages off a double bottom near $53-55. Three weeks ago (2026-07-16) Baker Hughes closed its $13.6B all-cash acquisition of Chart Industries, adding a data-center, gas-infrastructure and carbon-capture equipment franchise with $325M of targeted synergies by year three -- a real, closed deal, not a rumor. The balance sheet is net cash (net_debt_to_ebitda -3.37x) with $3.1B TTM free cash flow, insider selling is routine 10b5-1 plan activity only, and Stifel raised its price target to $75 the same morning. Unlike today's AI-momentum names (SNOW, HPE, ANET), which are selling off hard on a live, verified factor unwind, this setup is fundamentals- and catalyst-driven -- a deliberately orthogonal bet with no earnings inside the 90-day window (next print 2026-10-22).

proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Sell-side has largely modeled Baker Hughes as an oilfield-services/equipment cyclical tied to rig counts and oil capex; even after today's move, Stifel's freshly-raised $75 target implies the Street still sees ~26% upside from the pre-move close, meaning the market has not fully re-rated the print. MY VIEW: I believe the market is underpricing how fast Baker Hughes' Industrial & Energy Technology segment is becoming a data-center-power and gas-infrastructure equipment franchise rather than a pure oilfield play, a shift the newly-closed Chart Industries deal accelerates. RESOLUTION: the market gets full confirmation at the Q3 print (~2026-10-22, outside this trade's window) when IET backlog conversion and Chart synergy delivery either show through in guidance, or don't; inside this trade's window the thesis resolves via continued base-building and institutional accumulation above the $57-61 reclaim shelf.
